WebGL in Plotly and R

Source: vignettes/articles/r-docs/webgl-vs-svg-million-points.Rmd
webgl-vs-svg-million-points.Rmd

WebGL with 1 Million points 

library(plotly.core)

n <- 1e5
x <- rnorm(n)
y <- 2 * x + rnorm(n, sd = 5)

go_figure() |>
  add_scattergl(
    x = x,
    y = y,
    mode = "markers",
    marker = go_scattergl_marker(opacity = 0.01)
  )

Reference

See go_scattergl() for more information.
